posts.title: Bit propagation over a noisy grid
posts.description: Below is an open problem, an approachable problem, one perhaps you will be the one to solve! We send a bit over a noisy grid, starting from the origin and propagating out as a wave. Can we recover the original bit when looking at just the wavefront? posts.title: Cosmologically Unique IDs
posts.description: We are an exploratory species, just past the solar system now, but perhaps one day we will look back and call our galaxy merely the first.
